Fit a reusable Tumor2Line reference cohort

Source: R/07_prediction.R
fit_tumor2line_reference.Rd

Fits cohort-specific Tumor2Line PCA and uOT using an existing query cohort and candidate cell-line population. The fitted gene scaling, PCA loadings and PC scaling are retained so that newly arriving query samples can be projected into the same molecular space. New queries are added to the query population and uOT is rerun; no ranking-transfer mode is used.

Usage

fit_tumor2line_reference(
  query_expr,
  cellline_expr,
  phenotype = NULL,
  sample_id_col = "SampleID",
  pair_col = NULL,
  lineage_col = NULL,
  sample_type_col = NULL,
  query_type = "query",
  cellline_type = "cellline",
  query_input_scale = c("raw", "processed"),
  cellline_input_scale = c("raw", "processed"),
  n_variable_genes = 10000,
  pca_variance_threshold = 0.9,
  candidate_scope = c("within_lineage", "global"),
  distance = c("euclidean", "manhattan", "cosine"),
  epsilon = 0.1,
  rho_query = 1,
  rho_cellline = 1,
  max_iter = 5000,
  tolerance = 1e-08,
  evaluate = TRUE
)

Arguments

query_expr

Expression data for the query population. Samples are rows and genes are columns.

cellline_expr

Candidate cell-line expression data in the same orientation.

phenotype

Optional sample metadata.

sample_id_col

Sample-ID column name in expression data frames and phenotype.

pair_col

Optional known-pair column name. Set to `NULL` if unavailable.

lineage_col

Optional cancer-lineage column name. Required for `candidate_scope = "within_lineage"`.

sample_type_col

Optional biological sample-type column name.

query_type

Default biological label assigned to query samples.

cellline_type

Default biological label assigned to candidate cell lines.

query_input_scale

Input scale of query expression: `"raw"` (TPM) or `"processed"` (log2(TPM + 1)).

cellline_input_scale

Input scale of candidate expression.

n_variable_genes

Maximum number of variable genes.

pca_variance_threshold

Cumulative PCA variance threshold used to determine the number of retained PCs.

candidate_scope

Candidate pool: `"within_lineage"` or `"global"`.

distance

Distance metric used to construct the uOT cost matrix.

epsilon

Entropic regularization parameter.

rho_query

Query marginal-relaxation parameter.

rho_cellline

Cell-line marginal-relaxation parameter.

max_iter

Maximum Sinkhorn iterations.

tolerance

Sinkhorn convergence tolerance.

evaluate

Whether to evaluate known pairs automatically when available.

Value

An object of class `Tumor2LineReference`.
